newsitem.title: USA: CBOT wheat drops to day's lows late on spec sales.
newsitem.headline: CBOT wheat drops to day's lows late on spec sales.

text.p: CBOT wheat futures fell to day's lows in late dealings on low-volume speculative selling, traders said.
"It just kept fading and hit sell stops but there was really nothing in there but some light spec selling. The volume is light," a trader said.
The market was weakened in early dealings on overbought signals plus bearish input from the soy complex and on news Algeria and South Korea passed overnight on wheat tenders.
At 1245 CST, wheat was six to seven cents per bushel lower, with May down 6-1/2 at $3.91.
